harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 14 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on RHEL 7.9, with all replication traffic carried over TLS and authenticated via a cluster-dedicated CA. Only peers presenting a certificate issued by that CA can establish replication connections; connections without a client cert or with a cert not signed by the CA are rejected. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory restart protocol, each confirmed via a changed boot_id, with cluster health, TLS, and data verified recovered after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed PGDG repo and PostgreSQL 14 server/contrib on node1, node2, node3 (PG15 was blocked by missing libzstd/libicu on base RHEL7); fixed node2/node3 missing rhel-7-server-rpms base entitlement via subscription-manager refresh/attach

Generated a dedicated cluster CA (CN=pg-replication-cluster-ca, 10y validity) on node1 at /etc/pki/pg-repl-ca, plus per-node server certs (node1/node2/node3, with DNS+IP SANs) and a client cert for role 'replicator', all signed by that CA

Configured node1 as primary: ssl=on with CA-issued server cert, wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders/max_replication_slots=10, pg_hba.conf hostssl rules requiring cert clientcert=verify-full for the replication pseudo-db from each node's IP; opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all nodes
Generated the 'replicator' role's password on node1 itself (never exposed in tool commands) and created the REPLICATION LOGIN role

Cloned node2 and node3 from node1 via pg_basebackup -R using sslmode=verify-full with the replicator client cert, producing standby.signal and primary_conninfo with verify-full TLS automatically; installed each node's own CA-signed server cert and enabled ssl=on
Verified replication is active over TLS (pg_stat_replication + pg_stat_ssl showing ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384) and that data inserted on the primary appears on both standbys

Negative-tested access control: a connection with no client cert was rejected ('connection requires a valid client certificate') and a rogue self-signed cert with CN=replicator was rejected ('unknown ca')

Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes, then restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time) via systemctl reboot, polled each until SSH returned, confirmed a changed boot_id, and verified PostgreSQL, TLS, and replication/data health after each restart before proceeding to the next node
Inserted a post-restart row on the primary and confirmed it replicated over TLS to both standbys as final end-to-end verification

evidence.requirement: Streaming replication from node1 (primary) to node2 and node3 (standbys)
evidence.summary: Data inserted on node1 (repl_test rows) appears on node2 and node3, both confirmed as standbys via pg_is_in_recovery()=t, both before and after the restart cycle

evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a CA created for this cluster
evidence.summary: CA created on node1 (/etc/pki/pg-repl-ca/ca.crt), used to sign node/replicator certs; pg_stat_replication + pg_stat_ssl show both walsenders using ssl=t with ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, including after all node restarts

evidence.requirement: Only accept replication connections from peers presenting a certificate issued by the cluster CA
evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf configured with hostssl replication replicator <ip>/32 cert clientcert=verify-full for each node; a connection attempt with no client cert failed with 'connection requires a valid client certificate' and a rogue self-signed cert (CN=replicator, not CA-issued) failed with 'SSL error: tlsv1 alert unknown ca'

evidence.requirement: node1 restart with proof of changed boot identity and recovered cluster health
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d7a80301-53d3-4cc8-bd41-1293f67d0769 captured, systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect, post-restart boot_id d2482aeb-2309-4281-a75c-1f2864e60dd7 (changed), postgresql-14 active and both standbys re-streaming over TLS confirmed after restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart with proof of changed boot identity and recovered cluster health
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 192f6cab-c39d-4e64-a3f6-50e677966ca2 captured, reboot acknowledged before disconnect, post-restart boot_id 529f7272-6798-4706-922f-d9727c0e1767 (changed), postgresql-14 active, standby data intact (repl_test row present), and node1 shows node2 streaming again

evidence.requirement: node3 restart with proof of changed boot identity and recovered cluster health
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id ef457a88-7774-4b8f-82e6-ccbc965d83e2 captured, reboot acknowledged before disconnect, post-restart boot_id cea9f792-8828-4080-98be-7a99e93ef758 (changed), postgresql-14 active, standby data intact, and node1 shows node3 streaming again

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end verification after all restarts
evidence.summary: New row inserted on primary post-restart, confirmed replicated to both node2 and node3 over an active TLS session (ssl=t, ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384)
